# Adrevnview
# https://www.adrevnview.com

> Adrevnview is one shop for a local business. We make the website, the Google listing, the menus and print, the TV boards, the ads, the motion videos and the software. Based in Garden City, Long Island, New York. Most work is in New York. We work with businesses across the United States.

## About
- Name: Adrevnview
- Website: https://www.adrevnview.com
- Email: hello@adrevnview.com
- Phone: (516) 820-7863
- Address: 1225 Franklin Ave, Suite 300, Garden City, NY 11530, USA
- Area served: Long Island, New York, and the rest of the United States

## Who we work with
- Restaurants
- Bagel shops and delis
- Dessert shops and cafés
- Gyms and academies
- Barbershops and salons
- Clinics and med spas
- Stores

## Services
- Websites: business websites, website rebuilds, landing pages, online stores
- Google and AI search: search engine work (SEO), Google Business Profile care, setup so AI tools read the business correctly (GEO), free website check
- Ads and social: Google, Facebook and Instagram ads, social media posts, short videos, motion videos, email
- Print and screens: TV menu boards, restaurant menus, business cards, flyers, brochures, banners, letterheads, stickers, labels, packaging, logo and brand
- Software: ordering, booking, check-in and membership software

## Packages (starting prices; the exact price is given in writing after a short talk)
- Open the doors: from $1,500, one time. For a new business, or one starting over.
- Get found: from $500 a month. For a business that is open and wants more people to find it.
- Fill the room: from $1,000 a month, plus the ad budget. For a business ready to pay for more customers.

## Software we built
- Matzop (gyms and academies): https://matzop.com
- Cutzop (barbershops and salons): https://cutzop.com
- Doczop (clinics): https://doczop.com
- Taxzop (small US businesses): https://taxzop.com
- Bagelzop (bagel shops): customer ordering page, kitchen screen, owner dashboard
